name: stammgit
description: git-native family trees: your family as YAML in your own repo

paragraphs: AI-ready, Git-native family trees. Your family data lives in your own repository: YAML for people, Markdown for the chronicle, plain files for documents and photos. Git keeps the history; the archive outlives the app.

That makes the repository something an AI assistant can work with directly: tell it a story, let it add people, sources and chapters, run the validator, and review the diff before you merge. Everything can equally be edited in the browser, on your phone as well as on a desktop.
features: Family, descendants and combined ancestors & descendants views.
Descendants and combined views default to three generations, with a visible person count.
Semicircular ancestor fan with 1–10 generations, visible gaps and person information.
Fitted first family view, remembered zoom and stable graph position while reading
Partner-aware layouts that keep couples together and avoid splitting unrelated
